sources: recreation.gov public campsite search API for facility 10169615 (one non-reservable STANDARD NONELECTRIC entry)

values.note: First-come, first-served; pay at the self-pay station or with recreation.gov Scan & Pay (the forest page's 'Make Reservations Here' link leads to this Scan & Pay listing, which has no reservable sites). The Forest Service gives a 16-day stay limit; recreation.gov's Scan & Pay rule caps one purchase at 7 consecutive nights. Sites must be attended the first night and not left unattended more than 24 hours.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/hilltop-campground (Restrictions '16 day stay limit.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169615 (rules scanAndPay, maxConsecutiveStay 7; amenity 'Self Pay Station'; notice 'Campsites must be attended the first night...') + /rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-15, WalkInS&PStandard $15) + site search (no reservable site), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open annually from late May through mid-September, weather dependent.'

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/hilltop-campground (Seasons of Use; page last updated August 31, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 22 ft is the recommended maximum trailer length; the campground is reached by a steep, winding 3/4-mile drive from Cliff Lake Road.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/hilltop-campground ('18 shaded, quiet campsites'; 'The recommended maximum trailer length is 22 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water from three hydrants (recreation.gov: peak season). Garbage service May 15 - September 15. The Forest Service says bear-resistant food storage boxes are not available (recreation.gov lists a food storage locker). No cell service.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/hilltop-campground ('Amenities include a vault toilet and drinking water. Bear-resistant food storage boxes are not available'; 'Garbage services available May 15- September 15th'; 'No cell service.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10169615 ('four rustic outhouses and three fresh water hydrants'; amenity 'Drinking Water (peak season)'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Madison RD), atop a hill in old-growth Douglas fir midway between Cliff and Wade Lakes, ~37 mi south of Ennis (US 287, then FR 241 west 5 mi). Quiet, shaded sites away from the lakeshore crowds; fishing, swimming and small-boat boating at Cliff Lake (~1.25 mi) and Wade Lake (~1.75 mi, trail from camp). Reached by a steep, winding 3/4-mi drive; tight for anything near the 22-ft trailer limit. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Aug 31, 2026) + rec.gov: confirmed $15, 18 sites, 22-ft trailer limit, vault toilets, drinking water; changed booking reservable true/recreation.gov -> FCFS (rec.gov listing is Scan & Pay only, no reservable sites), added 16-day limit and season (late May - mid-Sept, not year-round). Hookups not stated.
